title: K-N Tiling (128×64): 3.31x speedup
technique: K_TILE=128, N_TILE=64, TQue DMA double buffer, fp32 UB accumulation
lesson: Tiling K=128 and N=64 with double-buffered DMA achieves 3.31x average speedup over scalar baseline. UB-local fp32 accumulation eliminates repeated global memory writes and maintains numerical precision.
